intro.text: An accountant who, with his colleague Mister Call, manages Wayne's money: a tall man in a bowler hat whom Wayne calls "Tall Boring Guy".

items.text: Wayne hated talking about money and kept dodging Garisel and Call, until they finally got him to their office by "trading" him a hat and glasses for a look at his ledgers. Asked to spread his risk, Wayne suggested a professional noseball league with an arena in every octant, sure it would lose money; Garisel saw promise in it and began planning straight away.
Once Wayne had died, Garisel and Call served as executors of his estate. They met Allriandre, his main heir, and gave Jaxy money to rebuild Ranette's shop.

appearance.text: Tall, usually in a bowler hat and a suit with a vest.

personality.text: He has a professional manner. According to Mister Call, women find him attractive and he has a girlfriend.
